blinded_power_amendment.reason: At the historical baseline firing rate, 100 terminal conditions imply only 16.16 baseline candidates and 3.65 losses. That makes the Wilson and loss-removal gates too discrete to distinguish the registered effect from sampling noise. The fixed 750-condition floor is a blinded sample-size strengthening made before any forward opportunity or outcome metric was generated.

realized_support_amendment.reason: The blinded power analysis selected 750 conditions because it made at least 100 baseline candidates and 15 baseline losses overwhelmingly likely, while the standing A+ policy requires at least 80 trades where applicable. Enforcing those realized counts prevents a small perfect sample from passing rate gates that were described as decision-useful.

residual_attribution_amendment.reason: Schema 6 records baseline, paired-book-validity, and frozen-residual comparators on identical sealed rows so residual magnitude cannot receive PnL or loss-removal credit without actual decision disagreements.

causal_tick_input_amendment.reason: Official venue documentation and unlabeled raw capture events establish a dynamic 0.01-to-0.001 tick transition. Reconstructing that transition causally from replayed top-of-book threshold crossings prevents a future early transition from making the frozen two-tick residual tolerance ten times too wide.

paired_book_reproduction_amendment.reason: The scorer must reproduce token-pair identity, microprices, complement residuals, dynamic-tick consistency, and executable-ask alignment from the serialized paired books instead of trusting derived residual fields.

execution_tick_parity_amendment.reason: Signal features, taker and maker entry prices, position state, exits, and cached live-replay must all consume the same persistent causal condition tick before executable profitability can be trusted.

live_runtime_tick_parity_amendment.reason: A future promoted runtime must ingest the venue's tick_size_change event without refreshing book age and propagate one causal condition tick through sizing, order rounding, signing, and submission.

capture_contract.recorded_replay_source: PMXT_DISTILLED_DIR with --require-shared-distilled; fallback to sidecar, parquet, or network is forbidden
capture_contract.reason: The capture variant preserves every non-edge baseline gate but uses impossible final edge thresholds so it emits no trades and does not truncate later counterfactual opportunities.

novelty_boundary.new_information: simultaneous causal state of both fully collateralized outcome books
novelty_boundary.historical_outcome_use: none; the rule and threshold were frozen before scoring the next forward block

feature_contract.sampling: decision-time state captured in the existing one-Hz pre-edge opportunity report
feature_contract.tick_size: initialize from a valid causal Gamma minimum_tick_size or 0.01; before each decision persist 0.001 for the condition after any replayed top-of-book bid or ask is positive and less than 0.04 or greater than 0.96
feature_contract.book_freshness: chosen_book_age_ms and opposite_book_age_ms must each be finite and in [0, 30000], matching the existing replay book-freshness contract
feature_contract.causality: only book events at or before decision_timestamp_s

fixed_rule.name: two_tick_binary_complement_coherence
fixed_rule.rationale: two venue ticks is a market-structure tolerance, not a label-fitted threshold

block_1.candidate_sampling: first chronological capture row per condition that reconstructs the registered baseline final edge pass: evaluation_result=low_edge, decision.zone=primary, and decision.edge>=0.07; the mechanism selects the first such row also passing the fixed rule
block_1.unit_economics_basis: one dollar of entry cost at each selected row's recorded decision ask, including the recorded Polymarket entry fee; this is an optimistic necessary screen before latency, depth, and fill simulation

block_2.rule_and_gates: identical to block_1, including minimum realized support, fee-aware unit profit factor >= 1.20, and payoff >= 0.20

promotion_boundary.next_if_both_blocks_pass: materialize exactly one runtime gate and run exact measured-latency replay with the schema-6 scorer plus a separately hash-pinned Linux measurement binary retaining causal execution, durable-order recovery, and live-runtime parity
required_exact_gates: positive fee-inclusive OOS PnL in both chronological halves

causal_tick_input.v5_switch_boundary: completed session 011 sealed under v4; active collection resumed as session 013 under v5 at 2026-07-20T15:42:38Z

scorer.precondition: refuses to reveal metrics until opportunity-report windows contain at least 750 post-registration terminal official-source settlement-aligned conditions under the blinded 2026-07-18 power amendment
scorer.realized_support_integrity: a completed block also rejects unless it contains at least 100 baseline candidates, 15 baseline losses, and 80 selected candidates; these thresholds were fixed before any forward strategy metric was inspected
scorer.label_policy: recomputes each selected row's win from the terminal manifest direction and rejects label mismatches
scorer.feature_integrity: recomputes paired token identity, both microprices, both complement residuals, dynamic-tick consistency, and executable-ask alignment from serialized raw fields before applying the frozen rule
scorer.attribution_integrity: publishes descriptive, non-gating baseline, paired-book-validity, and frozen-residual counts, win rates, fee-aware PnL, profit factor, maximum drawdown, incremental removals, and decision disagreements on identical sealed rows
scorer.source_integrity: records SHA-256 for every opportunity report and resolution manifest; repeat audit rereads each source and rejects any hash drift
scorer.wrapper_preflight: the replay wrapper counts unique post-registration terminal official-source-aligned conditions and refuses below 750 before generating any labeled opportunity report

exact_replay_execution.requirement: post-two-block exact replay must use this causal execution contract or a later hash-pinned equivalent

live_runtime_execution.requirement: any future production promotion must retain this live tick-event and order-path parity contract

live_runtime_reconciliation.requirement: any future production promotion must retain the confirmed-fill, current-fee, exact-maker-leg, authenticated-heartbeat, durable-order-journal, and authenticated REST recovery contract

authenticated_rest_recovery.requirement: any future production promotion must retain pre-submit hash journaling, strict startup restore, terminal-confirmed fill accounting, and periodic authenticated REST order/trade recovery

fee_aware_unit_economics.fee_model: shares * entry_fee_rate * price * (1 - price), rounded to five decimals
fee_aware_unit_economics.interpretation: The screen now rejects high-win-rate selections with inadequate pre-latency payoff geometry. Passing remains necessary but not sufficient for exact fee-inclusive replay profitability.

descriptive_diagnostics.selection_delay_seconds: selected decision timestamp minus the first baseline-eligible decision timestamp for the condition
descriptive_diagnostics.selected_seconds_to_close: condition open timestamp plus 300 seconds minus the selected decision timestamp
descriptive_diagnostics.baseline_and_selected_decision_ask: fresh top ask recorded for each row's chosen direction before latency and fill simulation
descriptive_diagnostics.same_direction_decision_ask_change: selected ask minus baseline ask only when both rows choose the same direction
descriptive_diagnostics.selected_in_final_60_seconds: count and rate of selected rows with no more than 60 seconds until the five-minute close
descriptive_diagnostics.selected_direction_changes: count and rate where the later selected row chooses the opposite direction from the first baseline-eligible row
descriptive_diagnostics.interpretation: These summaries expose whether a classification screen is benefiting from later, more expensive, or direction-reversed entries. They cannot pass or fail a block and cannot replace exact fee-inclusive runtime replay.

checks: capture and baseline identities match the frozen contract
condition hashes, counts, rates, fee-aware unit economics, gates, and verdicts recompute exactly

research_sources.title: Polymarket Positions and Tokens
research_sources.use: A binary Yes/No pair is fully backed by exactly one dollar and can be split or merged as a complete set.

research_sources.title: Polymarket Prices and Orderbook
research_sources.use: Executable prices are bids and asks; the displayed probability is normally the midpoint.

research_sources.title: Polymarket Fees
research_sources.use: The selected unit-economics screen applies the documented binary taker-fee formula and five-decimal rounding at the recorded entry ask.

research_sources.title: Polymarket Market Channel
research_sources.use: The venue emits tick_size_change when book price crosses below 0.04 or above 0.96; the documented transition is 0.01 to 0.001.

research_sources.title: Polymarket Orders Overview
research_sources.use: Order prices must conform to the current market tick, making contemporaneous tick reconstruction an execution-integrity input.

research_sources.title: Queue Imbalance as a One-Tick-Ahead Price Predictor in a Limit Order Book
research_sources.use: Depth imbalance can contain short-horizon information, motivating a depth-weighted microprice rather than midpoint-only parity.

research_sources.title: Cross-Impact of Order Flow Imbalance in Equity Markets
research_sources.use: Cross-book information should remain sparse and fixed; high-dimensional contemporaneous cross-impact is not assumed to add value.

research_sources.title: Liquidity and Prediction Market Efficiency
research_sources.use: Visible liquidity alone does not guarantee efficient prediction-market prices, so the feature is an uncertainty gate rather than a liquidity-is-good assumption.
